title: The Vanishing of the Old Cottage Librarian
intro_text: the Old Cottage librarian has vanished from Brindlebay overnight. Someone must have known more than they let on.

locations.name: Town Parking Lot
locations.description: An open lot where the only sounds are the distant caw of a crow and the occasional rustle of leaves in the breeze.

locations.name: Copper Kettle Cafe
locations.description: Inside, the air is thick with the smell of strong tea and freshly baked bread, mingling with the warmth of cozy conversations and the gentle clink of ceramic cups.

locations.name: Lane House
locations.description: A small, weathered cottage nestled along a serene lane, its windows casting an amber glow into the night sky. The soft rustle of leaves outside hints at secrets within.

methods.text: Method 1: sent them a forged note that pulled them away at night.
Method 2: lured them behind the sheds with a fake errand and never came back.
Method 3: tricked them into leaving town on the wrong coach.
Method 4: argued with them near the water and they never came back.

motives.text: Motive 1: keep an old secret buried.
Motive 2: inherit a small but useful sum.
Motive 3: end a feud that had been simmering for years.
Motive 4: clear the way for a new job posting.
